population.note_zh: 夏初人口约240万至270万（宋镇豪估计）

population.note_zh: 商初人口约400万至450万（宋镇豪估计）

population.note_zh: 永寿三年户口统计，东汉最高值

population.note_zh: 大明八年刘宋在籍人口

population.note_zh: 北齐577年灭亡时的在籍人口

population.note_zh: 乾元三年户口统计；战乱后大量人口脱离户籍

population.note_zh: 大观四年户口统计：2088万户，4673万口（多只统计男丁）

population.note_zh: 何炳棣对约1700年的估计

population.note_zh: 乾隆六年首次按口统计

population.note: Qing count of 1794
population.note_zh: 乾隆五十九年统计

population.note: Qing count of 1850, just before the Taiping war
population.note_zh: 道光三十年统计，太平天国战争前夕

faith.name: Erlitou turquoise dragon
faith.summary: A dragon made of over 2,000 turquoise pieces, buried with an elite man at Erlitou; an early sign of the dragon as a sacred symbol.
faith.summary_zh: 由两千多片绿松石拼成的龙形器，随葬于二里头一座贵族墓中，是龙作为神圣象征的早期证据。

faith.name: Bone divination at Erlitou
faith.summary: People at Erlitou burned animal shoulder blades and read the cracks to foretell events, a practice the Shang later developed.
faith.summary_zh: 二里头人灼烧兽骨，根据裂纹预测吉凶，这种做法后来被商人发展壮大。

faith.name: Erlitou palace-temple No. 1
faith.summary: A large walled hall on a rammed-earth platform with a courtyard for ceremonies, the earliest known palace-temple complex in China.
faith.summary_zh: 建在夯土台基上、带有庭院的大型殿堂，用于举行礼仪，是中国已知最早的宫殿宗庙建筑群之一。

faith.name: Erlitou turquoise-inlaid bronze plaques
faith.name_zh: 二里头嵌绿松石铜牌饰
faith.summary: Bronze plaques inlaid with turquoise in the shape of animal masks, worn by elites and probably used in rituals.
faith.summary_zh: 镶嵌绿松石的兽面纹铜牌饰，为贵族佩戴，可能用于祭祀等礼仪。

faith.name: Xibeigang royal cemetery
faith.summary: Huge cross-shaped tombs of Shang kings at Yinxu, with many human and animal sacrifices for the royal ancestors.
faith.summary_zh: 殷墟商王的大型十字形墓葬，伴有大量人牲和动物祭祀，体现了对王室祖先的崇拜。

faith.name: Worship of Di and the royal ancestors
faith.name_zh: 商人的上帝与祖先崇拜
faith.summary: Oracle bones show the Shang praying to Di, the high god, and to royal ancestors, who could send rain, harvests or disaster.
faith.summary_zh: 甲骨卜辞显示商人向至高神“帝”和王室祖先祈求，认为他们能降雨、赐丰年或降灾祸。

faith.name: Sanxingdui sacrificial pits
faith.summary: Pits filled with bronze masks, a tall bronze figure, a bronze tree and gold, left by an unknown religion in Sichuan.
faith.summary_zh: 坑中埋有青铜面具、青铜大立人、青铜神树和金器，反映了古蜀一种独特的宗教。

faith.name: Zhouyuan oracle bones
faith.summary: Inscribed divination bones from the Zhou homeland, showing the Zhou used Shang-style divination before the conquest.
faith.summary_zh: 周人故地出土的刻辞卜甲，说明周人在灭商之前也使用商式占卜。

faith.name: Mandate of Heaven
faith.summary: The Zhou claimed Heaven had taken the right to rule from the corrupt Shang and given it to them; the idea justified every later dynasty.
faith.summary_zh: 周人宣称上天收回了腐败商朝的统治权，转交给周；这一观念此后被历代王朝用来证明政权合法。

faith.name: Zhou ritual system
faith.summary: Rules of rank, ancestral sacrifice and music that ordered Zhou society; Confucius later held them up as the ideal.
faith.summary_zh: 规定等级、祭祖和礼乐的制度，维系周代社会秩序，后来被孔子视为理想。

faith.name: Jinsha site and the Sun Bird
faith.summary: Successor centre to Sanxingdui in Chengdu, rich in gold, jade and ivory; its gold Sun Bird disc shows sun worship.
faith.summary_zh: 成都的金沙遗址继三星堆而起，出土大量金器、玉器和象牙，金质太阳神鸟反映了太阳崇拜。

faith.name: Zhou Yi (Book of Changes)
faith.summary: A divination manual of 64 hexagrams whose core text dates to Western Zhou; it became a classic of both Confucian and Daoist thought.
faith.summary_zh: 以六十四卦占卜的书，核心部分形成于西周，后来成为儒家和道家共同推崇的经典。

faith.name: Zheng law code cast on bronze
faith.summary: Zheng published its laws on bronze cauldrons, an early step toward written public law that later fed Legalist thought.
faith.summary_zh: 郑国把法律铸在铜鼎上公之于众，是成文法公开的早期一步，后来影响了法家思想。

faith.name: Louguantai
faith.summary: In tradition the place where Laozi gave the Daodejing to the gatekeeper Yin Xi; later a major Daoist centre.
faith.summary_zh: 相传老子在此为关令尹喜讲授《道德经》，后来成为重要的道教圣地。

faith.name: Spring and Autumn Annals
faith.summary: Court chronicle of Lu for 722-481 BCE, said to be edited by Confucius; it became a Confucian classic and named the era.
faith.summary_zh: 鲁国从前722年到前481年的编年史，相传经孔子删修，成为儒家经典，也是“春秋”时代名称的由来。

faith.name: Temple of Confucius, Qufu
faith.summary: Founded in Confucius's old home a year after his death; it grew into the largest and oldest Confucian temple.
faith.summary_zh: 孔子去世次年在其故宅立庙，后来发展为规模最大、历史最久的孔庙。

faith.name: Mohist school
faith.summary: Mozi's followers formed a disciplined school that rivalled the Confucians for two centuries.
faith.summary_zh: 墨子门徒组成纪律严明的学派，与儒家并称显学。

faith.name: Jixia Academy
faith.summary: Academy at the Qi capital where scholars of many schools lived and debated, a heart of the Hundred Schools of Thought.
faith.summary_zh: 齐国都城的学宫，各派学者在此讲学辩论，是百家争鸣的中心。

faith.name: Shang Yang's reforms
faith.summary: Legalist reforms in Qin (rewards for farming and war, strict laws) that made Qin the strongest state.
faith.summary_zh: 秦国推行的法家改革，奖励耕战、严明法令，使秦国最强。

faith.name: Guodian bamboo slips
faith.summary: Chu tomb texts, found in 1993, that include the oldest known version of the Laozi (Daodejing) and early Confucian writings.
faith.summary_zh: 楚墓竹简（1993年出土），含已知最早的《老子》文本和早期儒家文献。

faith.name: Feng and Shan rites at Mount Tai
faith.summary: The First Emperor climbed Mount Tai to offer the feng and shan sacrifices to Heaven and Earth and set up an inscribed stele.
faith.summary_zh: 秦始皇登泰山行封禅大典，并立石刻颂功。

faith.name: Langya Terrace inscription
faith.summary: Stele on the coast of Shandong praising the unification; also where the First Emperor met fangshi seeking immortals.
faith.summary_zh: 山东海边颂扬统一的刻石，秦始皇也在此会见求仙方士。

faith.name: Shuihudi Qin bamboo slips
faith.summary: Bamboo slips from a local official's tomb recording Qin laws, showing Legalism in daily government.
faith.summary_zh: 秦代地方官吏墓中出土的竹简，记录秦律，展现法家治国的实际。

faith.name: Burning of books and burying of scholars
faith.summary: On Li Si's advice the Qin burned most private books except on medicine, divination and farming, and later killed scholars.
faith.summary_zh: 秦采纳李斯建议焚毁民间医药、卜筮、种树以外的书籍，次年又坑杀儒生方士。

faith.name: Han Gaozu's sacrifice to Confucius
faith.summary: Liu Bang offered a full sacrifice at Confucius's tomb in Qufu, the first emperor to honour him so.
faith.summary_zh: 刘邦过鲁以太牢祭祀孔子，是第一位祭孔的皇帝。

faith.name: Mawangdui silk texts
faith.summary: A tomb sealed in 168 BCE held silk manuscripts of the Laozi and Huang-Lao texts, showing early-Han Daoist thought.
faith.summary_zh: 公元前168年封闭的汉墓出土帛书《老子》和黄老文献，反映汉初道家思想。

faith.name: Imperial Academy (Taixue)
faith.summary: Emperor Wu founded the Imperial Academy to teach the Five Classics, making Confucian learning the path to office.
faith.summary_zh: 汉武帝设立太学，以五经教授弟子，儒学成为入仕之途。

faith.name: Emperor Wu's Feng and Shan rites
faith.summary: Emperor Wu performed the feng and shan sacrifices at Mount Tai, a high point of imperial state religion.
faith.summary_zh: 汉武帝在泰山举行封禅，是帝国国家祭祀的高峰。

faith.name: Shiqu Pavilion Council
faith.summary: Emperor Xuan gathered scholars in the palace library to settle differences in reading the Confucian classics.
faith.summary_zh: 汉宣帝召集儒生于石渠阁讨论五经异同。

faith.name: First Buddhist sutra taught in China
faith.summary: An envoy of the Yuezhi, Yicun, taught a Buddhist sutra orally to a Han student in Chang'an, the earliest record of Buddhism in China.
faith.summary_zh: 大月氏使者伊存在长安向博士弟子景卢口授佛经，是佛教传入中国的最早记载。

faith.name: Old Text classics made official
faith.summary: Under Wang Mang, Liu Xin's Old Text classics such as the Rites of Zhou were taught officially and used to justify reforms.
faith.summary_zh: 王莽时期，刘歆推崇的《周礼》等古文经被立于学官，并作为改制依据。

faith.name: Mandate omens (fuming)
faith.summary: Wang Mang used auspicious signs and prophecy texts to claim Heaven's mandate for his new dynasty.
faith.summary_zh: 王莽借符瑞和谶语宣称天命，建立新朝。

faith.name: Kingly fields reform
faith.summary: Inspired by the ideal well-field system of the classics, Wang Mang nationalised land and banned slave sales; it failed within three years.
faith.summary_zh: 仿经书井田理想，王莽宣布土地收归国有、禁止买卖奴婢，三年后失败。

faith.name: Wang Mang's Nine Temples
faith.summary: A huge complex of ancestral temples built in southern Chang'an following classical ritual; its ruins have been excavated.
faith.summary_zh: 按经典礼制在长安南郊修建的宏大宗庙建筑群，遗址已发掘。

faith.name: Prince Ying of Chu honours the Buddha
faith.summary: The earliest dated record of Buddhist worship in China, at the court of Prince Liu Ying in Pengcheng.
faith.summary_zh: 彭城楚王刘英供奉浮屠，是中国最早有明确纪年的佛教信仰记载。

faith.name: White Horse Temple
faith.summary: Traditionally China's first Buddhist temple, built at Luoyang after Emperor Ming's envoys returned.
faith.summary_zh: 相传是中国第一座佛寺，汉明帝遣使求法归来后在洛阳兴建。

faith.name: Way of the Celestial Masters
faith.summary: Zhang Daoling founded the first organised Daoist church at Mount Heming in Sichuan.
faith.summary_zh: 张道陵在蜀地鹤鸣山创立天师道，是最早的有组织道教。

faith.name: An Shigao's translations
faith.summary: The Parthian monk An Shigao began the first systematic translations of Buddhist texts at Luoyang.
faith.summary_zh: 安息僧人安世高来到洛阳，开始系统翻译佛经。

faith.name: Emperor Huan's sacrifices to Laozi
faith.summary: Emperor Huan sent officials to sacrifice to Laozi at his birthplace in Ku county, a sign of his deification.
faith.summary_zh: 汉桓帝遣使到苦县老子故里祭祀老子，标志老子被神化。

faith.name: Xiping Stone Classics
faith.summary: The official texts of the Confucian classics were carved on stone at the Imperial Academy in Luoyang.
faith.summary_zh: 在洛阳太学刻立儒家经典的官定文本。

faith.name: Way of Great Peace
faith.summary: Zhang Jue's healing cult from Julu launched the Yellow Turban Rebellion.
faith.summary_zh: 巨鹿张角创立太平道，184年发动黄巾起义。

faith.name: Confucius Temple restored at Qufu
faith.summary: Cao Pi ennobled a descendant of Confucius and had the temple at Qufu rebuilt.
faith.summary_zh: 曹丕封孔子后裔为宗圣侯，并下令重修曲阜孔庙。

faith.name: Xuanxue (Dark Learning)
faith.summary: In the Zhengshi era Luoyang scholars began reading the classics through Daoist ideas of non-being.
faith.summary_zh: 正始年间，洛阳学者以道家“贵无”思想解释经典，玄学由此兴起。

faith.name: Zhengshi Stone Classics
faith.summary: Classics carved in three scripts were set up at the Imperial Academy in Luoyang.
faith.summary_zh: 在洛阳太学刻立以古文、小篆、隶书三体书写的经典。

faith.name: Jianchu Temple
faith.summary: The Sogdian monk Kang Senghui founded the first Buddhist temple south of the Yangtze at Jianye.
faith.summary_zh: 康居僧人康僧会在建业建立江南第一座佛寺。

faith.name: First monastic precepts
faith.summary: The Indian monk Dharmakala translated monastic rules at Luoyang, allowing proper ordination of Chinese monks.
faith.summary_zh: 印度僧人昙柯迦罗在洛阳译出戒本，汉地僧人自此依律受戒。

faith.name: Seven Sages of the Bamboo Grove
faith.summary: A circle of poets and thinkers who met at Shanyang, drinking and rejecting court ritual.
faith.summary_zh: 一群诗人与思想家聚于山阳竹林，饮酒清谈，蔑视礼法。

faith.name: Guozixue (Imperial School)
faith.summary: Emperor Wu of Jin founded a school for the sons of nobles, the forerunner of the Guozijian.
faith.summary_zh: 晋武帝设立国子学，是后世国子监的前身。

faith.name: Fotudeng arrives in Luoyang
faith.summary: The Central Asian monk Fotudeng won over the Later Zhao rulers and spread Buddhism across the north.
faith.summary_zh: 西域僧人佛图澄来到洛阳，后得后赵君主信奉，使佛教在北方广泛传播。

faith.name: Shangqing revelations at Maoshan
faith.summary: Yang Xi's revelations near Mount Mao began the Shangqing school of Daoism.
faith.summary_zh: 杨羲在茅山一带受“降授”经书，开创道教上清派。

faith.name: Mogao Caves
faith.summary: The monk Lezun cut the first cave near Dunhuang; over a thousand years it grew into a vast art treasury.
faith.summary_zh: 僧人乐僔在敦煌开凿第一个石窟，此后千年发展为巨大的艺术宝库。

faith.name: Donglin Temple
faith.summary: Huiyuan's temple on Mount Lu, later seen as the birthplace of Pure Land Buddhism.
faith.summary_zh: 慧远在庐山所建寺院，后被视为净土宗的发源地。

faith.name: Maijishan Grottoes
faith.summary: Cave temples begun under the Later Qin (384–417) near Tianshui.
faith.summary_zh: 天水麦积山石窟始凿于后秦时期（384–417年）。

faith.name: Bingling Temple
faith.summary: Its cave 169 has an inscription of 420, the oldest dated cave inscription in China.
faith.summary_zh: 第169窟有420年的题记，是中国最早有纪年的石窟题记。

faith.name: Kou Qianzhi's Northern Celestial Masters
faith.summary: Kou Qianzhi reformed Celestial Master Daoism and won it status as the Northern Wei state religion at Pingcheng.
faith.summary_zh: 寇谦之改革天师道，在平城得到北魏朝廷尊崇，一度成为国教。

faith.name: Yungang Grottoes
faith.summary: The monk Tanyao began giant Buddha caves near Pingcheng after the persecution of 446 ended.
faith.summary_zh: 太武帝灭佛之后，僧人昙曜在平城附近开凿巨大佛像石窟。

faith.name: Longmen Grottoes
faith.summary: Carving began when the Northern Wei moved its capital to Luoyang.
faith.summary_zh: 北魏迁都洛阳之际开始开凿。

faith.name: Shaolin Monastery
faith.summary: Emperor Xiaowen built it on Mount Song for the Indian monk Batuo.
faith.summary_zh: 孝文帝在嵩山为印度僧人跋陀建寺。

faith.name: Tongtai Temple
faith.summary: Emperor Wu of Liang, a devout Buddhist, built it in Jiankang and several times 'gave himself' to it.
faith.summary_zh: 笃信佛教的梁武帝在建康建造此寺，并多次舍身入寺。

faith.name: Zhiyi on Mount Tiantai
faith.summary: Zhiyi retreated to Mount Tiantai, where he shaped the first fully Chinese school of Buddhism.
faith.summary_zh: 智顗入天台山修行讲学，创立第一个完全本土化的佛教宗派天台宗。

faith.name: Xuandu Temple
faith.summary: A major Daoist temple built in the new capital Daxing.
faith.summary_zh: 隋文帝营建大兴城时修建的著名道观。

faith.name: School of the Three Stages
faith.summary: Xinxing's popular Buddhist movement in the capital, later banned.
faith.summary_zh: 信行在京城创立的佛教派别，后来被朝廷禁止。

faith.name: Guoqing Temple
faith.summary: Built after Zhiyi's death; the home temple of the Tiantai school.
faith.summary_zh: 智顗去世后建成，是天台宗的祖庭。

faith.name: Renshou relic stupas
faith.summary: Emperor Wen sent Buddha relics to some 30 prefectures to be enshrined in stupas.
faith.summary_zh: 隋文帝下诏分送佛舍利到约三十个州建塔供奉。

faith.name: Imperial Academy (Guozijian)
faith.summary: Emperor Yang made the state Confucian school a separate office, the Guozijian.
faith.summary_zh: 隋炀帝将国子寺改为国子监，成为独立的最高学府。

faith.name: Four Gates Pagoda
faith.summary: The oldest surviving stone pagoda in China, near Jinan.
faith.summary_zh: 位于济南附近，是中国现存最早的石塔。

faith.name: Huaisheng Mosque
faith.summary: By tradition one of the oldest mosques in China, built for Arab traders in Guangzhou.
faith.summary_zh: 相传为中国最早的清真寺之一，为广州的阿拉伯商人所建。

faith.name: Jokhang Temple
faith.summary: Built under Songtsen Gampo; the holiest temple of Tibetan Buddhism.
faith.summary_zh: 松赞干布时期建造，是藏传佛教最神圣的寺庙。

faith.name: Giant Wild Goose Pagoda
faith.summary: Built to house the sutras Xuanzang brought back from India.
faith.summary_zh: 为保存玄奘从印度带回的佛经而建。

faith.name: Correct Meaning of the Five Classics
faith.summary: Kong Yingda's official commentaries, the standard for the civil exams.
faith.summary_zh: 孔颖达等编撰的官方经学注疏，成为科举考试的标准。

faith.name: Longmen: Fengxian Temple Buddha
faith.name_zh: 龙门奉先寺卢舍那大佛
faith.summary: The great Vairocana Buddha at the Longmen Grottoes, completed with Empress Wu's support.
faith.summary_zh: 龙门石窟卢舍那大佛，在武后资助下完成。

faith.name: Leshan Giant Buddha
faith.summary: The largest stone Buddha in the world, carved 713–803.
faith.summary_zh: 世界最大的石刻佛像，713—803年凿成。

faith.name: Uyghurs adopt Manichaeism
faith.summary: The Uyghur khagan made Manichaeism the state religion after a visit to Luoyang.
faith.summary_zh: 回鹘可汗在洛阳接触摩尼教后，将其立为国教。

faith.name: Nestorian Stele
faith.summary: Records the Church of the East in China since the monk Alopen arrived in 635.
faith.summary_zh: 记载了自635年阿罗本来华以来景教在中国的传播。

faith.name: Confucius temple at the Liao Upper Capital
faith.summary: Abaoji ordered a Confucian temple, plus Buddhist and Daoist temples, at his new capital.
faith.summary_zh: 阿保机下令在上京修建孔子庙及佛寺、道观。

faith.name: Shu Stone Classics
faith.summary: Later Shu carved the Confucian classics with commentary on stone in Chengdu.
faith.summary_zh: 后蜀在成都把儒家经典连同注文刻在石碑上。

faith.name: Fayan school of Chan
faith.summary: Fayan Wenyi taught in Jinling; the last of the 'Five Houses' of Chan.
faith.summary_zh: 法眼文益在金陵开创，是禅宗五家中最晚的一家。

faith.name: Wuyue's 84,000 stupas
faith.summary: King Qian Hongchu of Wuyue had 84,000 small stupas made, each holding a printed sutra.
faith.summary_zh: 吴越王钱弘俶造八万四千座小塔，塔内藏印本佛经。

faith.name: Later Zhou restricts Buddhism
faith.summary: Emperor Shizong closed over 30,000 temples and melted bronze statues into coins.
faith.summary_zh: 周世宗废除三万多所寺院，熔铜像铸钱。

faith.name: Yunyan Pagoda (Tiger Hill)
faith.summary: Brick pagoda in Suzhou, begun 959 and finished 961; now it leans.
faith.summary_zh: 苏州砖塔，959年始建，961年建成，今已倾斜。

faith.name: Kaibao Canon
faith.summary: The first printed Buddhist canon, carved on some 130,000 blocks in Chengdu.
faith.summary_zh: 第一部雕版印刷的佛教大藏经，在成都刻版约13万块。

faith.name: Longxing Temple
faith.summary: Its huge bronze Guanyin was cast on Emperor Taizu's order.
faith.summary_zh: 宋太祖下令铸造的巨大铜观音像在此。

faith.name: Yuelu Academy
faith.summary: One of the four great Song academies, at Changsha.
faith.summary_zh: 宋代四大书院之一，位于长沙。

faith.name: Qingjing Mosque
faith.summary: Mosque of Quanzhou's Arab merchants; one of China's oldest.
faith.summary_zh: 泉州阿拉伯商人所建，是中国最古老的清真寺之一。

faith.name: Iron Pagoda
faith.summary: Brick pagoda in Kaifeng covered in iron-coloured glazed tiles.
faith.summary_zh: 开封的砖塔，外贴铁色琉璃砖，故称铁塔。

faith.name: Yingxian Wooden Pagoda
faith.summary: Liao-built, the oldest and tallest all-wood pagoda in the world.
faith.summary_zh: 辽代建造，是世界上现存最古老、最高的木塔。

faith.name: Sakya Monastery
faith.summary: Founded by Khön Könchok Gyalpo; seat of the Sakya school.
faith.summary_zh: 昆·贡却杰布创建，是萨迦派的主寺。

faith.name: Zhenghe Daoist Canon
faith.summary: The first printed Daoist canon, cut in Fuzhou under Emperor Huizong.
faith.summary_zh: 宋徽宗时在福州刊刻，是第一部雕版印刷的道藏。

faith.name: Quanzhen School
faith.summary: Wang Chongyang founded Quanzhen Daoism in Shandong, teaching the unity of Daoism, Buddhism and Confucianism.
faith.summary_zh: 王重阳在山东创立全真道，主张三教合一。

faith.name: Goose Lake Meeting
faith.summary: Zhu Xi and Lu Jiuyuan debated the right way to learn at Goose Lake Temple.
faith.summary_zh: 朱熹与陆九渊在鹅湖寺辩论治学方法。

faith.name: Dazu Rock Carvings (Baodingshan)
faith.summary: The monk Zhao Zhifeng spent about 70 years carving the Baodingshan Buddhist grottoes.
faith.summary_zh: 僧人赵智凤历时约七十年开凿宝顶山石刻。

faith.name: White Deer Grotto Academy
faith.summary: Zhu Xi restored the academy at Mount Lu and wrote its rules, a model for later academies.
faith.summary_zh: 朱熹重建庐山白鹿洞书院并订立学规，成为后世书院的典范。

faith.name: Tiantong Temple
faith.summary: The Japanese monk Dōgen studied Chan here and took Sōtō Zen back to Japan.
faith.summary_zh: 日本僧人道元在此学禅，归国后开创日本曹洞宗。

faith.name: Changchun Palace (White Cloud Temple)
faith.summary: After meeting Genghis Khan, Qiu Chuji made this Beijing temple the centre of Quanzhen Daoism.
faith.summary_zh: 丘处机觐见成吉思汗后，以燕京此观为全真道中心。

faith.name: Liangzhou meeting
faith.summary: Sakya Pandita met the Mongol prince Köden, beginning the tie between Tibetan Buddhism and the Mongols.
faith.summary_zh: 萨迦班智达与蒙古阔端会面，西藏佛教与蒙古从此建立联系。

faith.name: Longhu Mountain
faith.summary: Kublai put the Celestial Master Zhang Zongyan of Longhushan in charge of Daoism in the south.
faith.summary_zh: 忽必烈命龙虎山天师张宗演主领江南道教。

faith.name: White Dagoba, Miaoying Temple
faith.summary: A Tibetan-style stupa in Dadu designed by the Nepali craftsman Araniko.
faith.summary_zh: 尼泊尔工匠阿尼哥设计的大都藏式白塔。

faith.name: Feilai Feng carvings
faith.summary: Yuan-era Tibetan-style Buddhist rock carvings near Lingyin Temple, Hangzhou.
faith.summary_zh: 杭州灵隐寺旁的元代藏传风格佛教石刻。

faith.name: Catholic mission in Khanbaliq
faith.summary: John of Montecorvino reached Dadu, built churches and became its first Catholic archbishop.
faith.summary_zh: 孟高维诺来到大都建立教堂，后任首位天主教总主教。

faith.name: Temple of Confucius, Beijing
faith.summary: Built in Dadu next to the Imperial Academy (Guozijian) to honour Confucius.
faith.summary_zh: 在大都修建，与国子监相邻，祭祀孔子。

faith.name: Cloud Platform at Juyong Pass
faith.summary: Gateway carved with Buddhist texts in six scripts: Sanskrit, Tibetan, 'Phags-pa, Uyghur, Chinese and Tangut.
faith.summary_zh: 门洞刻有梵、藏、八思巴、回鹘、汉、西夏六种文字的佛经。

faith.name: Ganden Monastery
faith.summary: Founded by Tsongkhapa, the mother monastery of the Gelug (Yellow Hat) school.
faith.summary_zh: 宗喀巴创建，为格鲁派（黄教）祖寺。

faith.name: Wudang Mountains
faith.summary: The Yongle Emperor built a huge complex of Daoist temples here to the god Zhenwu.
faith.summary_zh: 永乐帝在此为真武大帝修建规模宏大的道教宫观群。

faith.name: Temple of Heaven
faith.summary: Built by the Yongle Emperor for the emperor's sacrifices to Heaven.
faith.summary_zh: 永乐帝修建，供皇帝祭天。

faith.name: Id Kah Mosque
faith.summary: Kashgar's great mosque, the largest in Xinjiang.
faith.summary_zh: 喀什的大清真寺，新疆最大的清真寺。

faith.name: Hu Dengzhou's scripture-hall teaching
faith.summary: Hu Dengzhou began teaching Islam in mosques in Shaanxi, a system that spread among the Hui.
faith.summary_zh: 胡登洲在陕西开创清真寺经堂教育，后在回族中普及。

faith.name: Dazhao Temple, Hohhot
faith.summary: Built by Altan Khan after he met the Third Dalai Lama, helping Tibetan Buddhism spread among the Mongols.
faith.summary_zh: 俺答汗会见三世达赖后修建，推动藏传佛教在蒙古传播。

faith.name: St Paul's Church, Macau
faith.name_zh: 澳门圣保禄教堂（大三巴）
faith.summary: Jesuit church in Macau, a base for missions to China and Japan.
faith.summary_zh: 耶稣会在澳门的教堂，是向中国和日本传教的基地。

faith.name: Donglin Academy
faith.summary: Gu Xiancheng revived it in Wuxi; its scholars criticised court corruption.
faith.summary_zh: 顾宪成在无锡重建，学者在此议论朝政。

faith.name: Nantang (South Church), Beijing
faith.name_zh: 北京南堂（宣武门天主堂）
faith.summary: Matteo Ricci's residence and chapel, the first Catholic church in Beijing in the Ming.
faith.summary_zh: 利玛窦的住所和礼拜堂，明代北京第一座天主教堂。

faith.name: Potala Palace
faith.summary: The Fifth Dalai Lama began rebuilding the Potala as palace and seat of government.
faith.summary_zh: 五世达赖喇嘛开始重建布达拉宫，作为宫殿和政教中心。

faith.name: Labrang Monastery
faith.summary: One of the six great Gelug monasteries, in Xiahe, Gansu.
faith.summary_zh: 格鲁派六大寺院之一，位于甘肃夏河。

faith.name: Yonghe Temple (Lama Temple)
faith.summary: Yongzheng's former palace, made a Tibetan Buddhist temple by Qianlong.
faith.summary_zh: 雍正帝潜邸，乾隆时改为藏传佛教寺院。

faith.name: Putuo Zongcheng Temple
faith.summary: A Chengde temple modelled on the Potala Palace.
faith.summary_zh: 承德仿布达拉宫修建的寺庙。

faith.name: Robert Morrison in Canton
faith.summary: The first Protestant missionary in China; he translated the Bible and made a Chinese-English dictionary.
faith.summary_zh: 第一位来华新教传教士，翻译《圣经》并编纂华英字典。

faith.name: God Worshipping Society at Jintian
faith.summary: Hong Xiuquan's Christian-inspired sect rose here, starting the Taiping Rebellion.
faith.summary_zh: 洪秀全受基督教影响的拜上帝会在此起义，太平天国运动开始。

faith.name: Wanmu Caotang
faith.summary: Kang Youwei's school in Guangzhou, which trained reformers like Liang Qichao.
faith.summary_zh: 康有为在广州开办的学堂，培养了梁启超等维新人士。

inventions.name: Cast bronze ritual vessels
inventions.summary: Erlitou workshops cast wine vessels such as the jue in multi-piece clay moulds, the earliest bronze ritual vessels in China.
inventions.summary_zh: 二里头作坊用多块陶范铸造爵等酒器，这是中国最早的青铜礼器。

inventions.name: Oracle bone script
inventions.summary: Shang diviners carved questions and answers on turtle shells and ox bones; it is the earliest mature Chinese writing, ancestor of today's characters.
inventions.summary_zh: 商代占卜者把问卜内容刻在龟甲和牛骨上，这是最早成熟的汉字，是今天汉字的祖先。

inventions.name: Houmuwu ding
inventions.summary: A rectangular cauldron weighing about 830 kg, cast in clay moulds; the heaviest bronze vessel known from ancient China.
inventions.summary_zh: 用陶范铸成、重约830公斤的长方形大鼎，是中国古代已知最重的青铜器。

inventions.name: Mao Gong ding inscription
inventions.summary: A bronze cauldron with 497 cast characters, the longest known bronze inscription; it records a royal charge from King Xuan.
inventions.summary_zh: 鼎内铸有497字铭文，是已知最长的青铜器铭文，记录了周宣王的册命。

inventions.name: Jade-handled iron sword of Guo
inventions.place_zh: 上村岭虢国墓地（今河南三门峡）
inventions.summary: A short sword with an iron blade found in a Guo lord's tomb, among the earliest smelted iron objects in China.
inventions.summary_zh: 出土于虢国国君墓中的铁刃短剑，是中国最早的人工冶铁制品之一。

inventions.name: Earliest record of Halley's Comet
inventions.summary: The Spring and Autumn Annals note a comet entering the Big Dipper in 613 BCE, widely taken as the first record of Halley's Comet.
inventions.summary_zh: 《春秋》记载前613年“有星孛入于北斗”，一般认为是世界上关于哈雷彗星的最早记录。

inventions.name: Cast-iron law cauldron of Jin
inventions.summary: Jin collected iron to cast a cauldron bearing its laws, one of the earliest written mentions of cast iron in China.
inventions.summary_zh: 晋国征收铁来铸造刻有刑法的鼎，是中国关于铸铁的最早文字记载之一。

inventions.name: Sword of Goujian
inventions.summary: A tin-bronze sword with diamond patterns and an inscription naming King Goujian, still sharp and unrusted when found.
inventions.summary_zh: 饰有菱形暗纹、铭有越王勾践之名的青铜剑，出土时依然锋利、几乎没有锈蚀。

inventions.name: Han Canal (Hangou)
inventions.summary: Wu dug a canal linking the Yangtze and Huai rivers, the earliest section of what became the Grand Canal.
inventions.summary_zh: 吴国开凿连接长江和淮河的运河，是后来大运河最早的一段。

inventions.name: Bells of Marquis Yi of Zeng
inventions.summary: A set of 65 cast bronze bells, each sounding two notes, showing advanced bronze casting and music theory.
inventions.summary_zh: 65件青铜编钟，每钟可发两音，体现高超的铸造技术和乐律知识。

inventions.name: Dujiangyan irrigation system
inventions.summary: A weir system that splits the Min River to control floods and irrigate the Chengdu Plain; it still works today.
inventions.summary_zh: 分流岷江以防洪灌溉成都平原的水利工程，至今仍在使用。

inventions.name: Zhengguo Canal
inventions.summary: A long irrigation canal from the Jing River that enriched Qin's Guanzhong farmland and helped Qin unify China.
inventions.summary_zh: 引泾水灌溉关中的大型水渠，使秦国富强，助其统一六国。

inventions.name: Ban liang coin
inventions.summary: Round bronze coin with a square hole made the standard currency of the empire; its shape lasted 2,000 years.
inventions.summary_zh: 圆形方孔铜钱成为全国统一货币，此形制沿用两千年。

inventions.name: Lingqu Canal
inventions.summary: Canal linking the Xiang and Li rivers, so the Yangtze and Pearl River systems were joined for Qin's southern campaign.
inventions.summary_zh: 连接湘江与漓江，沟通长江与珠江水系，供秦军南征运粮。

inventions.name: Qin Great Wall
inventions.summary: Earlier state walls were joined into a long northern wall against the Xiongnu.
inventions.summary_zh: 连接原有各国长城，修筑抵御匈奴的万里长城。

inventions.name: Qin Straight Road
inventions.summary: A roughly 700 km military highway running north from near Xianyang to Jiuyuan on the frontier.
inventions.summary_zh: 从咸阳附近向北直达边郡九原、长约700公里的军事大道。

inventions.name: Terracotta Army
inventions.summary: Thousands of life-size clay soldiers buried near the First Emperor's tomb, showing mass production with standard parts.
inventions.summary_zh: 秦始皇陵旁数千个真人大小的陶俑，体现标准化批量生产。

inventions.name: Early hemp paper
inventions.summary: Fragments of hemp-fibre paper from Western Han tombs show paper existed well before Cai Lun.
inventions.summary_zh: 西汉墓中出土的麻纤维纸残片，说明蔡伦以前已有纸。

inventions.name: Wuzhu coin
inventions.summary: Standard coin of Emperor Wu, cast by the central mint from 113 BCE; used for over 700 years.
inventions.summary_zh: 汉武帝时的标准钱币（前113年起由中央铸造），沿用七百余年。

inventions.name: Jade burial suit of Liu Sheng
inventions.summary: A full-body suit of about 2,500 jade plates sewn with gold wire, found in a prince's tomb.
inventions.summary_zh: 约2500片玉片用金丝缀成的全身葬服，出自中山靖王墓。

inventions.name: Taichu calendar
inventions.summary: New official calendar that started the year in the first month and fitted the 24 solar terms into the calendar.
inventions.summary_zh: 以正月为岁首、将二十四节气纳入历法的新官方历法。

inventions.name: Multi-tube seed drill
inventions.summary: Ox-drawn drill that sowed seeds in neat rows, promoted with Zhao Guo's alternating-field farming.
inventions.summary_zh: 牛拉的条播农具，随赵过的代田法推广。

inventions.name: Earliest dated sunspot record
inventions.summary: The History of Han records a black spot on the Sun in 28 BCE, the oldest dated sunspot observation.
inventions.summary_zh: 《汉书》记载河平元年（前28年）日中有黑气，是有确切日期的最早黑子记录。

inventions.name: Fan Shengzhi's farming manual
inventions.summary: China's earliest surviving agricultural treatise, describing pit-field farming and seed treatment.
inventions.summary_zh: 现存最早的农书之一，记述区田法与种子处理。

inventions.name: Xin standard measure
inventions.summary: A bronze standard vessel defining units of volume; its dimensions imply a value of pi of about 3.1547.
inventions.summary_zh: 规定容量单位的青铜标准量器，其尺寸推算圆周率约为3.1547。

inventions.name: Bronze sliding caliper
inventions.summary: Dated bronze caliper with a sliding jaw, the oldest known caliper of this kind.
inventions.summary_zh: 带有纪年铭文的青铜卡尺，有滑动量爪，是已知最早的此类卡尺。

inventions.name: Wang Mang's coinage
inventions.summary: Wang Mang issued many new coins (knife coins, spade coins, huoquan); repeated changes caused economic chaos.
inventions.summary_zh: 王莽发行刀币、布币、货泉等多种新钱，屡次改币造成经济混乱。

inventions.name: Recorded dissection
inventions.summary: Wang Mang had physicians dissect an executed rebel and measure his organs, one of the earliest recorded dissections.
inventions.summary_zh: 王莽令太医解剖被处决的王孙庆并测量脏腑，是最早的解剖记录之一。

inventions.name: Feathered gliding attempt
inventions.summary: The History of Han records a man with bird-feather wings gliding a few hundred paces before falling.
inventions.summary_zh: 《汉书》载有人以鸟羽为翼，飞行数百步后坠落。

inventions.name: Water-powered bellows
inventions.summary: A waterwheel drove the bellows of iron furnaces, saving labour and raising output.
inventions.summary_zh: 利用水力鼓动冶铁炉的风箱，省力又提高产量。

inventions.name: Improved papermaking
inventions.summary: Cai Lun made cheap paper from bark, hemp, rags and fishing nets, which slowly replaced bamboo and silk.
inventions.summary_zh: 蔡伦用树皮、麻头、破布和渔网造纸，成本低廉，逐渐取代竹简和缣帛。

inventions.name: Water-powered celestial globe
inventions.summary: A water clock turned a model of the sky so that it kept time with the real stars.
inventions.summary_zh: 以漏壶流水驱动浑象转动，使其与实际天象同步。

inventions.name: Seismoscope
inventions.summary: A bronze vessel that dropped a ball from a dragon's mouth to show the direction of a distant earthquake.
inventions.summary_zh: 铜制仪器，龙口吐珠以指示远方地震的方向。

inventions.name: Square-pallet chain pump
inventions.summary: A chain of paddles lifted water uphill; it later became the standard irrigation pump of Chinese farms.
inventions.summary_zh: 用链板把水提升到高处，后来成为中国农田最常见的灌溉工具。

inventions.name: Wooden ox
inventions.summary: Wheeled carts (probably a kind of wheelbarrow) used to carry grain over mountain roads to Shu's armies.
inventions.summary_zh: 用于在山路上为蜀军运粮的车具，可能是一种独轮车。

inventions.name: South-pointing chariot
inventions.summary: A two-wheeled cart whose differential gearing kept a figure pointing the same way, with no magnet.
inventions.summary_zh: 利用差速齿轮使车上木人始终指向一个方向，并不使用磁石。

inventions.name: Liu Hui's value of pi
inventions.summary: In his commentary on the Nine Chapters, Liu Hui used polygons inside a circle to calculate pi as about 3.14.
inventions.summary_zh: 刘徽注《九章算术》，用割圆术求得圆周率约为3.14。

inventions.name: Principles of map-making
inventions.summary: Pei Xiu set out six rules for maps, including a scale grid, and drew a great atlas of the empire.
inventions.summary_zh: 裴秀提出包括比例尺在内的“制图六体”，并绘制《禹贡地域图》。

inventions.name: Precession of the equinoxes
inventions.summary: Yu Xi noticed that the stars at the solstices slowly shift, and calendars began to allow for it.
inventions.summary_zh: 虞喜发现冬至点在恒星间缓慢移动，此后历法开始考虑岁差。

inventions.name: Sweet wormwood for fevers
inventions.summary: Ge Hong's handbook told how to soak sweet wormwood to treat fevers; it guided the discovery of artemisinin in the 1970s.
inventions.summary_zh: 葛洪《肘后备急方》记载以青蒿绞汁治疟，启发了20世纪70年代青蒿素的发现。

inventions.name: Paired stirrups
inventions.summary: The tomb of the Northern Yan noble Feng Sufu held one of the earliest known pairs of stirrups, which let riders fight firmly on horseback.
inventions.summary_zh: 北燕冯素弗墓出土世界最早的成对马镫之一，使骑兵能稳坐马上作战。

inventions.name: Daming calendar
inventions.summary: The first Chinese calendar to include the precession of the equinoxes, with a very accurate year length.
inventions.summary_zh: 中国第一部引入岁差的历法，回归年长度十分精确。

inventions.name: Zu Chongzhi's pi
inventions.summary: He showed pi lies between 3.1415926 and 3.1415927 and gave 355/113 as a close value, unmatched for about 900 years.
inventions.summary_zh: 算出圆周率在3.1415926与3.1415927之间，并给出密率355/113，领先世界约九百年。

inventions.name: Qimin Yaoshu
inventions.summary: The oldest complete Chinese farming manual, covering crops, animals, brewing and food.
inventions.summary_zh: 现存最早最完整的中国农书，涵盖作物、畜牧、酿造和食品加工。

inventions.name: Co-fusion steelmaking
inventions.summary: Molten cast iron was poured over wrought iron to make steel for sharp sabres.
inventions.summary_zh: 把生铁熔化浇灌在熟铁上炼成钢，用以制造锋利的宿铁刀。

inventions.name: Zhaozhou Bridge
inventions.summary: The world's oldest open-spandrel stone arch bridge, still standing.
inventions.summary_zh: 世界上现存最早的敞肩石拱桥，至今仍在使用。

inventions.name: Huangji calendar
inventions.summary: First calendar to use quadratic interpolation for the uneven motion of the sun.
inventions.summary_zh: 首次用二次内插法计算太阳不均匀运动的历法。

inventions.name: Grand Canal
inventions.summary: Canals linking the Yellow River and the Yangtze, centred on Luoyang, tied north and south together.
inventions.summary_zh: 以洛阳为中心连接黄河与长江的运河网，把南北连成一体。

inventions.name: Newly Revised Materia Medica
inventions.summary: The first pharmacopoeia issued by a state, describing 850 drugs.
inventions.summary_zh: 世界上第一部由国家颁布的药典，收药850种。

inventions.name: Tang sancai glazed pottery
inventions.summary: Lead-glazed pottery in green, amber and cream, made mostly for tombs.
inventions.summary_zh: 以绿、黄、白等色铅釉烧成的陶器，多用作陪葬品。

inventions.name: Measuring a meridian arc
inventions.summary: Shadow measurements from north to south gave the length of one degree of latitude.
inventions.summary_zh: 南北多地测量日影，算出了地球子午线一度的长度。

inventions.name: Flying money
inventions.summary: Paper certificates that let merchants move money between provinces without carrying coins.
inventions.summary_zh: 商人凭券异地取钱，免去携带铜钱之苦，是纸币的先驱。

inventions.name: Printed Diamond Sutra
inventions.summary: Found at Dunhuang, it is the oldest dated printed book in the world.
inventions.summary_zh: 在敦煌发现，是世界上现存最早有确切日期的印刷书籍。

inventions.name: Curved-shaft plough
inventions.summary: A lighter, easier-to-turn plough described by Lu Guimeng, used in the south for centuries.
inventions.summary_zh: 陆龟蒙记载的轻便易转的犁，此后在南方沿用千年。

inventions.name: Petrol flamethrower
inventions.summary: Wuyue used a pump that sprayed burning oil in a naval battle with Wu.
inventions.summary_zh: 吴越在与吴国的水战中使用喷射燃油的器械。

inventions.name: Printing of the Nine Classics
inventions.summary: The state printed the Confucian classics (932–953), making them cheap and widely available.
inventions.summary_zh: 官府雕版印刷儒家经典（932—953年），使经书价廉易得。

inventions.name: Printed Guanyin images
inventions.summary: Dunhuang's ruler had single-sheet Buddhist pictures printed in large numbers.
inventions.summary_zh: 敦煌归义军节度使曹元忠大量雕印单页观音像。

inventions.name: Fire lance
inventions.summary: A tube of gunpowder on a spear; first shown in a Buddhist banner from Dunhuang.
inventions.summary_zh: 把火药筒绑在长矛上的武器，最早见于敦煌出土的佛教绢画。

inventions.name: Jiaozi paper money
inventions.summary: The world's first government-issued paper money, in Sichuan.
inventions.summary_zh: 在四川发行，是世界上第一种官方纸币。

inventions.name: Bronze acupuncture figures
inventions.summary: Life-size bronze models marked with acupuncture points, used to teach and test doctors.
inventions.summary_zh: 标有穴位的真人大小铜像，用于教学和考核医生。

inventions.name: Gunpowder formulas
inventions.summary: A military manual gave the first written recipes for gunpowder.
inventions.summary_zh: 军事著作《武经总要》首次记载了火药配方。

inventions.name: Movable type printing
inventions.summary: Bi Sheng printed with reusable clay characters, as Shen Kuo recorded.
inventions.summary_zh: 毕昇用可重复使用的胶泥活字印刷，见沈括记载。

inventions.name: Jia Xian's triangle
inventions.summary: A triangle of binomial coefficients, used to find roots of numbers.
inventions.summary_zh: 二项式系数三角形，用于开方。

inventions.name: Needle compass and declination
inventions.summary: Shen Kuo described the magnetic needle compass and noted it points slightly east of south.
inventions.summary_zh: 沈括记载了磁针指南，并指出它“常微偏东”。

inventions.name: Astronomical clock tower
inventions.summary: A water-driven tower with an armillary sphere and an escapement mechanism.
inventions.summary_zh: 以水为动力、带擒纵机构和浑仪的天文钟塔。

inventions.name: Treatise on Architectural Methods
inventions.summary: The state building manual setting standard designs and modules.
inventions.summary_zh: 官方颁布的建筑规范，规定了标准做法和模数。

inventions.name: Pictures of Tilling and Weaving
inventions.summary: Illustrated poems showing every step of rice farming and silk making, widely copied later.
inventions.summary_zh: 以图配诗描绘种稻和养蚕织布的全部工序，后世多有摹刻。

inventions.name: Huizi paper money
inventions.summary: The Southern Song government issued huizi notes, which became the main money of the south.
inventions.summary_zh: 南宋政府发行会子，成为东南地区的主要货币。

inventions.name: Paddle-wheel warships at Caishi
inventions.summary: Treadmill-driven paddle-wheel ships helped the Song beat a Jin crossing of the Yangtze.
inventions.summary_zh: 以脚踏驱动明轮的车船帮助宋军在长江击退金军渡江。

inventions.name: Thunder-crash bomb
inventions.summary: Jin defenders used iron-cased gunpowder bombs against the Mongols at the siege of Kaifeng.
inventions.summary_zh: 金军在开封保卫战中用铁壳火药炸弹抵御蒙古军。

inventions.name: Rain and snow gauges
inventions.summary: Qin Jiushao's book shows how to work out rainfall and snowfall from basins, an early form of rain gauge.
inventions.summary_zh: 秦九韶书中用盆测算降雨降雪量，是早期的雨量计算法。

inventions.name: Tuhuoqiang (bamboo gun)
inventions.summary: A thick bamboo tube that fired a projectile with gunpowder, an ancestor of the gun.
inventions.summary_zh: 用粗竹筒以火药发射弹丸，是管形火器的先驱。

inventions.name: Gaocheng Observatory
inventions.summary: A giant gnomon tower for measuring the sun's shadow precisely, part of a nationwide survey.
inventions.summary_zh: 用于精确测量日影的巨型圭表台，是全国天文测量的一部分。

inventions.name: Shoushi calendar
inventions.summary: Set the year at 365.2425 days, the same as the later Gregorian calendar.
inventions.summary_zh: 定一年为365.2425日，与后来的格里历相同。

inventions.name: Huitong Canal
inventions.summary: A canal across Shandong that let the Grand Canal run straight north to Dadu.
inventions.summary_zh: 贯通山东的运河，使大运河可以直达大都。

inventions.name: Wooden movable type with revolving tables
inventions.summary: Wang Zhen carved over 30,000 wooden characters and set type from revolving tables.
inventions.summary_zh: 王祯刻木活字三万多个，并用转轮排字架拣字。

inventions.name: Xanadu Gun
inventions.summary: A small bronze hand cannon dated 1298, among the oldest dated guns in the world.
inventions.summary_zh: 铸有大德二年铭文的铜火铳，是世界上有纪年的最早火铳之一。

inventions.name: Two-colour woodblock printing
inventions.summary: A Diamond Sutra with commentary printed in red and black, the oldest known colour print in China.
inventions.summary_zh: 以朱、墨两色印成的《金刚经注》，是现存最早的套色印本。

inventions.name: Yongle Encyclopedia
inventions.summary: A vast encyclopedia of 22,877 chapters copying books from all fields.
inventions.summary_zh: 共22877卷，汇集各类典籍的巨型类书。

inventions.name: Forbidden City
inventions.summary: The vast wooden palace complex, finished in 1420, which remains the largest in the world.
inventions.summary_zh: 1420年建成的宫殿建筑群，至今仍是世界上最大的木结构宫殿群。

inventions.name: Bronze movable type
inventions.summary: Hua Sui of Wuxi printed books with bronze movable type.
inventions.summary_zh: 无锡华燧用铜活字印书。

inventions.name: Pan Jixun's Yellow River works
inventions.summary: Narrowed the Yellow River with dikes so the faster water would scour away its silt.
inventions.summary_zh: 筑堤束水，用加快的水流冲刷河沙（束水攻沙）。

inventions.name: Twelve-tone equal temperament
inventions.summary: Prince Zhu Zaiyu calculated the exact tuning that divides the octave into 12 equal steps.
inventions.summary_zh: 朱载堉精确算出把八度音分为十二个相等半音的方法。

inventions.name: Abacus arithmetic manual
inventions.summary: A popular manual that taught calculation on the abacus across East Asia.
inventions.summary_zh: 普及珠算的著作，在东亚广泛流传。

inventions.name: Red barbarian cannons at Ningyuan
inventions.summary: European-style cannons helped Yuan Chonghuan beat Nurhaci's attack on Ningyuan.
inventions.summary_zh: 西洋式火炮帮助袁崇焕在宁远击退努尔哈赤。

inventions.name: Ten Bamboo Studio colour prints
inventions.summary: Multi-block colour woodblock printing of paintings with soft shading.
inventions.summary_zh: 以多块套版印出带有浓淡变化的彩色画谱。

inventions.name: Verbiest's instruments at the Beijing Observatory
inventions.summary: Six large bronze European-style instruments made for the Beijing observatory.
inventions.summary_zh: 为北京观象台铸造的六件欧式大型铜制天文仪器。

inventions.name: Kangxi Atlas
inventions.summary: A map of the empire based on surveys by Jesuits and Qing officials, the most accurate of its time in Asia.
inventions.summary_zh: 由传教士和清朝官员实地测绘而成，是当时亚洲最精确的地图。

inventions.name: Complete Library of the Four Treasuries
inventions.summary: The largest book collection in Chinese history, copied by hand (though many books were also censored).
inventions.summary_zh: 中国历史上规模最大的丛书，全部手抄，但编修时也禁毁了许多书。

inventions.name: Huanghu steamboat
inventions.summary: The first steamboat designed and built by Chinese engineers.
inventions.summary_zh: 第一艘由中国人自行设计制造的蒸汽轮船。

inventions.name: Jiangnan Arsenal
inventions.summary: Self-Strengthening arsenal making guns and ships and translating Western science books.
inventions.summary_zh: 洋务运动中的兵工厂，制造枪炮轮船，并翻译西方科技书籍。

inventions.name: Fuzhou Navy Yard
inventions.summary: Shipyard and naval school that built modern warships.
inventions.summary_zh: 建造近代军舰并设立船政学堂的造船厂。

inventions.name: Tangxu railway
inventions.summary: A short line built to carry coal from the Kaiping mines, the start of China's lasting railways.
inventions.summary_zh: 为运输开平煤矿的煤而修建，是中国铁路持续发展的开端。

inventions.name: Machine-struck silver dragon dollar
inventions.summary: The Guangdong mint began striking modern silver coins with a dragon design.
inventions.summary_zh: 广东钱局开始用机器铸造龙纹银元。
